# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the problem and solution. Link related issues.

## Verification

List commands and manual checks run, results, and anything not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no secrets or private data.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests and ran applicable checks.
- [ ] I preserved archive provenance and append-only behavior, or explained a proposed change for review.
- [ ] For UI changes, I recorded keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, and contrast checks or explained gaps (see ACCESSIBILITY.md).
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and the project change records where applicable.

Do not submit vulnerability details in a public pull request. Follow SECURITY.md first.
